mapper.select: SELECT role_code AS "roleCode", role_name AS "roleName", purpose, assignment_criteria AS "assignmentCriteria", default_data_scope AS "defaultDataScope" FROM role ORDER BY role_code
SELECT role_code AS "roleCode", role_name AS "roleName", purpose, assignment_criteria AS "assignmentCriteria", default_data_scope AS "defaultDataScope" FROM role WHERE role_code = #{roleCode}
mapper.update: UPDATE role SET role_name = #{roleName}, purpose = #{purpose}, assignment_criteria = #{assignmentCriteria}, default_data_scope = #{defaultDataScope}, updated_at = current_timestamp WHERE role_code = #{roleCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO change_history ( change_history_id, entity_name, entity_id, before_value, after_value, actor_user_id, changed_at, reason, status ) VALUES ( #{changeHistoryId}, #{entityName}, #{entityId}, CAST(#{beforeValue} AS jsonb), CAST(#{afterValue} AS jsonb), #{actorUserId}, current_timestamp, #{reason}, 'RECORDED' )
